title: atmos.gas_stratified
description: M14B § gas stratification producer — per-step atmos.gas_stratified event emitted when a gas's fraction shifts between cells in the same vertical column. `cell_id` identifies the cell, `gas` is one of the canonical Stationeers gas labels (h2/he/methane/water_vapor/n2/o2/co2/n2o/pollutant/volatiles), `fraction_delta` is the signed change (positive when the cell gained the gas, negative when it lost). Producer fills at M14B. Additive-only per M4 DR-002.
